# Entrupy

> > AI-powered authentication technology for luxury goods, specializing in handbag verification for brands like Chanel, Louis Vuitton, Hermès, Dior, Gucci, and Fendi.

Entrupy is a New York-based company providing product authentication solutions using artificial intelligence and machine learning for retail, resale markets, and supply chain protection. The platform offers instant verification of luxury items with a focus on counterfeit detection and fraud prevention.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered authentication
- Counterfeit detection
- Luxury handbag authentication
- Chanel authentication
- Louis Vuitton authentication
- Hermès authentication
- Resale market verification
- Product authentication technology
- Supply chain protection
- Return fraud prevention
- Certificate of Authenticity
- Sneaker authentication
- Brand launches (Fendi, Céline, Dior, Gucci, Prada)
- Leather authentication (Clemence, Togo, Epsom)
